import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    df = inputs["readings"].copy()

    cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    is_bad = df["value"].isnull() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)
    df["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    grp = df.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"].agg(total_rows="size", bad_row_count="sum").reset_index()
    grp["bad_row_count"] = grp["bad_row_count"].astype(int)
    grp["quarantined"] = grp["bad_row_count"] * 100 > grp["total_rows"] * 20
    grp["batch_reject_pct"] = (grp["bad_row_count"] * 100.0 / grp["total_rows"]).round(2)

    df = df.merge(grp[["batch_id", "quarantined", "batch_reject_pct"]], on="batch_id", how="left")

    quarantine_mask = df["quarantined"]

    readings_quarantine = df.loc[quarantine_mask, cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].copy()

    non_q = df.loc[~quarantine_mask]
    readings_clean = non_q.loc[~non_q["_is_bad"], cols].copy()
    readings_rejects = non_q.loc[non_q["_is_bad"], cols].copy()

    return {
        "readings_clean": readings_clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_rejects": readings_rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_quarantine": readings_quarantine.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
